description: Patch releases of MediaWiki are deliberately not automerged here, unlike in most other roles in this fleet.

This role never migrates the database. Applying a new image is one playbook run; running MediaWiki's own `maintenance/run.php update` is a separate, explicitly invoked one (`--tags=update-mediawiki`). An automerged bump therefore reaches a wiki whose schema is still the old one, and MediaWiki's upgrade manual asks for update.php after any upgrade, point releases included.

A wiki in that state does not fail visibly: started on 1.46.0 with a database installed by 1.43.9, it answers, reports itself as `MediaWiki 1.46.0` through api.php, and renders its existing pages, while every edit fails with `internal_api_error_DBQueryError`. That is a read-only wiki which looks entirely healthy.

The Molecule run that would gate the automerge does not cover this. It installs the bumped version from scratch and exercises it, which says nothing about the in-place upgrade of an existing wiki - the only path an automerged bump ever takes on a user's host. Automerging on that evidence would drop the human review without CI having tested what the review is for.
